rows.question: Is the 2026 results feed complete and correct through Week 10?
rows.known: All 137 games are read from nfl.com game-page URLs; W-L-T/PF/PA reconcile 32/32 with the live standings captured 2026-11-14.
rows.unknown: Week 10 Sunday and Monday results (Nov 15–16) are not yet played as of the capture date.

rows.question: Which replacement is the depth chart rank of each Out/Questionable starter?
rows.known: Week 10 official injury rows (14 Out, 11 Questionable). Live spot check: 7 of 9 sample rows match; 2 differ (F-L9).
rows.unknown: Official starter/backup depth is not published on the pages checked; replacement rank is unknown.

rows.question: Does our model beat the naive baseline out of sample with enough certainty to earn a gate pass?
rows.known: Holdout (weeks 8–10, n=30): accuracy 0.733 vs 0.500; placebo p 0.0076 for accuracy.
rows.unknown: MAE-improvement bootstrap 95% CI [-2.47, 3.74] includes 0; holdout n=30 is far below G2 (300).
rows.unlock: More prospective weeks; more graded selections.

rows.question: What closing-line beat rate does any strategy achieve?
rows.known: Nothing is measurable: no closing numbers exist in the repository.

rows.question: What stake size and bankroll rule should the staking column use?
rows.known: nfl-command gates.json sets a 2% maximum per selection and a -15% drawdown stop.
rows.unknown: Whether the bankroll rule is acceptable to the owner; no bankroll is defined.

rows.question: Are the correlations stable enough to use in pricing?
rows.known: Two model-internal phi values measured (n=105 each), with split-half values.
rows.unknown: Market correlations cannot be computed (Q-L1); player-prop correlations have no official data.
rows.unlock: Q-L1 and an official player-log source (SUG-L4).

rows.question: Should any strategy be live at all this season?
rows.known: No strategy passes all gates (leaderboard.json: 0 of 6 registered).
